headline: DeepSeek Prices Live Web Retrieval
lede: DeepSeek’s new Search and Fetch APIs put live web access behind a simple meter: successful requests cost less than a tenth of a cent each. Filters, Markdown conversion, and read-only access make the service a practical substrate for research agents—if quality and bot policy cooperate.

headline: A Quiz Gate for AI-Written Code
lede: Sphinx turns the code review checkpoint into a pop quiz. This open-source Git hook asks developers to explain an AI-generated diff before protected branches can ship, recording the skips when understanding loses to momentum.

headline: The Documentary That Makes Doubt Its Subject
lede: A new reading of the Elizabeth Holmes documentary treats its manipulation as the point, not a flaw. Through framing, edits, and selective disclosure, the film makes viewers feel how quickly a story can outrun the evidence.
pullquote: A documentary can expose deception while demonstrating how easily storytelling manufactures belief.

headline: Parser Combinators Turn Small Rules Into Parsers
lede: Regex breaks down when structure arrives. Parser combinators compose small functions into readable grammars, offering a practical middle ground between ad hoc patterns and a full parser generator.

headline: Healthy Coral Neighbors Help Bleached Fragments Recover
lede: In laboratory experiments, bleached Pocillopora fragments recovered their algal partners after touching a healthy fragment from the same genetic individual. The tissue bridge is precise, promising, and not yet a reef-scale solution to marine heat stress.

headline: Teal Adds Types Without Leaving Lua
lede: Teal brings annotations, records, unions, interfaces, and generics to Lua while compiling back to ordinary Lua. It preserves the language’s small-runtime character and gives larger projects a sharper way to catch mistakes—including those supplied by coding models.

headline: Lean Fortifies Its Kernel With Verified Checks
lede: Lean now ships independent and formally verified kernel paths for rechecking projects. Paranoid mode adds multiple kernels and hardened memory, narrowing the trust base beneath increasingly large formal developments.

headline: TEEs Are Not Automatic Sanctuaries
lede: Trusted execution environments can fail at the enclave, attestation, key, hardware, or revocation layer. Treat remote approval as a threat-model input—not proof that valuable secrets are safe.

headline: DeepSeek Ships a Faster Million-Token Model
lede: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 arrives under the MIT license with a one-million-token context window and updated reasoning, coding, agentic, and visual performance. Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and local inference workflows are supported from launch.

headline: Small Dam Removals Reopen Eastern Rivers
lede: Across the Northeast, removing obsolete dams and culverts is restoring routes for alewives, shad, lamprey, and salmon. The work is ecological repair and infrastructure triage at once, constrained by permitting, money, and the history people attach to old barriers.
